# industry classification

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:industryClassification`](gmeow-industryClassification.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/industryClassification>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an organization to an industry-classification identifier — a NAICS, ISIC, or schema.org industry code. The scheme is declared via [`gmeow:identifierScheme`](gmeow-identifierScheme.md) on the [`Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) node. Non-functional: multiple classifications may coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) -> [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasIdentifier`](gmeow-hasIdentifier.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:industryClassification`](gmeow-industryClassification.md) from [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) to [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach an industry-code [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) to an organization — a NAICS, ISIC, or schema.org industry code — the org-scoped specialization of [`gmeow:hasIdentifier`](gmeow-hasIdentifier.md) for sector classification.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for legal-registration codes (use [`gmeow:legalIdentifier`](gmeow-legalIdentifier.md)) and avoid expressing the sector as an [`Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) subclass — the code is a reified [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md) value, not a class ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint a [`gmeow:Identifier`](../classes/gmeow-Identifier.md), set its [`gmeow:identifierScheme`](gmeow-identifierScheme.md) (e.g. "naics") and [`gmeow:identifierValue`](gmeow-identifierValue.md), then attach with [`gmeow:industryClassification`](gmeow-industryClassification.md) and let [`gmeow:hasIdentifier`](gmeow-hasIdentifier.md) follow by subsumption.

### Examples

- ex:acme [`gmeow:industryClassification`](gmeow-industryClassification.md) ex:acmeNaics.
